body.zh: Tibo 已宣布全球额度重置完成。可刷新查看当前账号额度。
body.en: Tibo has announced that the global quota reset is complete. Refresh to check your account’s current quota.

appliesTo.zh: 所有付费 ChatGPT 账户

body.zh: Tibo 已宣布本次额度重置处理完成。可刷新查看当前账号额度。
body.en: Tibo has announced that the reset has been processed. Refresh to check your account’s current quota.

title.zh: 将赠送一次可留存重置
title.en: One banked reset to be added

body.zh: Tibo 宣布向所有付费账户补入一次可留存的重置次数，并在回复中称会在“EOD PST”前到账。尚未确认全部发放完成；可查看当前账号的可用重置次数。
body.en: Tibo announced one banked reset for all paid accounts, with a reply saying it will be there by “EOD PST”. Full delivery has not been confirmed; check your account’s available resets.
